notes.title: Combat Demo - Patch 0.23
notes.notes:
Good evening travelers!

A few important game-breaking bugs have been resolved, including a few additions as per requested by the community. Continue to report bugs and we'll continue to improve!

[h1]Patch 0.23[/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]ADDED:[/b] Chatting now starts immediately when opening Chatbox
    [*][b]ADDED:[/b] Y-Axis Invert Option
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Gamepad Ability UI showing up on round-start randomly
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Can switch stance during an attack and deal damage in current stance (even though past stance is lower damage)
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Clients dealt the same damage for all Stances
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback, see you in the next one!

notes.title: Combat Demo - Patch 0.22
notes.notes:
Hello travelers!

We've received a lot of feedback about the Combat in these past few days, we're excited to get it all pushed into the full-game to craft an experience that we can all enjoy!

We've also received a lot of bug reports, there are a few that are still being investigated but besides those, we were able to fix the other issues. We've also balanced a few things in the Demo to [i]hopefully[/i] make the experience more enjoyable.

[h1]Patch 0.22[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Players that were hit during an ability at low HP didn't die, this should be fixed (0 HP bug)
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] The Loadout Selection sometimes didn't show, this should be fixed (if not, let us know)
    [*][b]CHANGED:[/b] Lowered Base Damages of the Polearm from 25 to 20
    [*][b]CHANGED:[/b] Health Orbs now only regenerate 50 HP, rather than 100
    [*][b]REMOVED:[/b] Removed the 'Play Against Bots' button on the Main Menu
[/list]

Some users were encountering high GPU usage, we're still investigating this issue!

Thanks for all the bug reports!

notes.title: Combat Demo - Patch 0.21
notes.notes:
Hello travelers!

Yesterday we released Patch 0.2 which contained a few fixes and additions, today we'll be releasing another patch which includes a bunch of bug fixes that you've submitted!

If you're playing the Combat Demo and encounter a bug, please feel free to post on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/776070/discussions/1/]Discussion Hub[/url], we'll investigate and crush the bug as soon as we can!

[h1]Patch 0.21[/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Keymaps aren't saving
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] If chat menu is up when you press ESC, you can close it and glitch out the menu (cursor disappears)
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Timer is going under 0:00
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Master Volume should now operate as intended
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Able to hit dead bodies, causing animation issues
    [*][b]REMOVED:[/b] First Person [i]for now[/i]
[/list]

The Combat Demo should be officially released tomorrow!

Thanks for all of the bug reports, see you in the next patch!

notes.title: Combat Demo - Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The Combat Demo is exclusively out for Discord members at the moment, due to poor planning, the public build is still under review by Steam. However, Crimson felt bad that it's not out when he said it'd be out; you can get an early key of the Combat Demo by going to our [url=https://discord.gg/QYfhtKY]Discord[/url]! Thanks for all the support, other than that, let's get right into the patch notes.

The Combat Demo is a little buggy at the moment, still playable but it has a few issues. We've recently added a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/776070/discussions/1/]Discussion Hub[/url] so you can report bugs and any feedback that you may have for the game.

This is the very first public patch, so let us know if there are any bugs or if anything wasn't fixed below:

[h1]PATCH 0.2[/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]NEW:[/b] Added a Latency and FPS counter at the top
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Players can attack in the Spectator Podium
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] The 'Report a Bug' button in the Escape Menu should now function properly.
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] On start-up, VR apps such as the Oculus and Steam VR open up, this shouldn't happen anymore.
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Raycasts and debugging tools were showing up in-game, this should not happen anymore.
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] News Screen showing the holster key has been fixed.
    [*][b]FIXED:[/b] Pressing Escape whilst in the Loadout Selection and then pressing it again hides the cursor, hopefully that pesky mouse stays from now on.
[/list]

That should be it, thanks for the help, let's continue making the game better!
